title: I missed Dota Underlords, so I started making my own autobattler with AI
author: Kanzes
selftext:
Hey everyone! I posted about BLACKBELL yesyerday but it got removed because I didn't really understand Rule 4. My apologies to the mods! Figured I'd give it another shot, this time actually sharing how I've been making the game.

I started making BLACKBELL because I really missed Dota Underlords and wanted something with a similar feel that I could just play solo & offline on my Steam Deck.

The process honestly hasn't been "one prompt and done" at all. I tried a bunch of things that didn’t really work for me : Spine 2D, Aseprite, even learning a bit of Blender because I originally thought the game might be 3D. I also tried Minimax H3 for sprites (it kept giving me too many smears for the look I want), H3 worked better for cutscene-style stuff and 'single simple action' instead (hence i'm using it for the hub sprite). 

What ended up working better for me was making rough sketches of character references first, it doesnt have to be DETAILED as long as it's clear enough what you want, you can generate the colors, fidelity, etc through GPT/Krea2, and then just let Claude redraw and iterate from there. Even then, most of it still took a lot of passes, you need some manual cleanup/polish in Photoshop. (it's better for your subscriptions rather than prompting it, especially the hands and fingers).  I spent around two months just redrawing, fixing animations that doesn't seem right, and trying to keep the characters and overall style consistent.

I do work in a creative field for my day job, so I guess that helped a bit with the visual direction and knowing what I wanted things to look like... but realistically, making something like this on my own would've never been possible for me without AI. especially with the amount of time I have outside work.

On the code/gameplay side, AI has helped a lot too, but releasing the demo also reminded me pretty quickly that automated testing still doesn’t replace actual players... people immediately pointed out UI and balance issues I had completely missed haha.

Anyway, BLACKBELL is my first game, and I put together this trailer for Steam’s Auto-Battler Fest this week:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5409210/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5409210/)

curious how other people here deal with that part of AI dev where it gets you maybe 70% there... and then the last 30% takes forever.
